verses.he: וּמִן־הַתְּכֵ֤לֶת וְהָֽאַרְגָּמָן֙ וְתֹולַ֣עַת הַשָּׁנִ֔י עָשׂ֥וּ בִגְדֵי־שְׂרָ֖ד לְשָׁרֵ֣ת בַּקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֞וּ אֶת־בִּגְדֵ֤י הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְאַהֲרֹ֔ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ פ
verses.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلْأَسْمَانْجُونِيِّ وَٱلْأُرْجُوَانِ وَٱلْقِرْمِزِ صَنَعُوا ثِيَابًا مَنْسُوجَةً لِلْخِدْمَةِ فِي ٱلْمَقْدِسِ، وَصَنَعُوا ٱلثِّيَابَ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَةَ ٱلَّتِي لِهَارُونَ، كَمَا أَمَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى.
verses.en: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made plaited garments, for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.kjv: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy [place], and made the holy garments for Aaron; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.web: Of the blue, purple, and scarlet, they made finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

verses.he: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת־הָאֵפֹ֑ד זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתֹולַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָֽר׃
verses.ar: فَصَنَعَ ٱلرِّدَاءَ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَأَسْمَانْجُونِيٍّ وَأُرْجُوَانٍ وَقِرْمِزٍ وَبُوصٍ مَبْرُومٍ.
verses.en: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.kjv: And he made the ephod [of] gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.web: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

verses.he: וַֽיְרַקְּע֞וּ אֶת־פַּחֵ֣י הַזָּהָב֮ וְקִצֵּ֣ץ פְּתִילִם֒ לַעֲשֹׂ֗ות בְּתֹ֤וךְ הַתְּכֵ֙לֶת֙ וּבְתֹ֣וךְ הָֽאַרְגָּמָ֔ן וּבְתֹ֛וךְ תֹּולַ֥עַת הַשָּׁנִ֖י וּבְתֹ֣וךְ הַשֵּׁ֑שׁ מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה חֹשֵֽׁב׃
verses.ar: وَمَدُّوا ٱلذَّهَبَ صَفَائِحَ وَقَدُّوهَا خُيُوطًا لِيَصْنَعُوهَا فِي وَسَطِ ٱلْأَسْمَانْجُونِيِّ وَٱلْأُرْجُوَانِ وَٱلْقِرْمِزِ وَٱلْبُوصِ، صَنْعَةَ ٱلْمُوَشِّي.
verses.en: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into threads, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, the work of the skilful workman.
verses.kjv: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut [it into] wires, to work [it] in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, [with] cunning work.
verses.web: They beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in with the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen, the work of the skillful workman.

verses.he: כְּתֵפֹ֥ת עָֽשׂוּ־לֹ֖ו חֹבְרֹ֑ת עַל־שְׁנֵ֥י *קִצְוֹותֹו (קְצֹותָ֖יו) חֻבָּֽר׃
verses.ar: وَصَنَعُوا لَهُ كَتِفَيْنِ مَوْصُولَيْنِ. عَلَى طَرَفَيْهِ ٱتَّصَلَ.
verses.en: They made shoulder-pieces for it, joined together; at the two ends was it joined together.
verses.kjv: They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple [it] together: by the two edges was it coupled together.
verses.web: They made shoulder straps for it, joined together. It was joined together at the two ends.

verses.he: וְחֵ֨שֶׁב אֲפֻדָּתֹ֜ו אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלָ֗יו מִמֶּ֣נּוּ הוּא֮ כְּמַעֲשֵׂהוּ֒ זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתֹולַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.ar: وَزُنَّارُ شَدِّهِ ٱلَّذِي عَلَيْهِ كَانَ مِنْهُ كَصَنْعَتِهِ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَأَسْمَانْجُونِيٍّ وَقِرْمِزٍ وَبُوصٍ مَبْرُومٍ، كَمَا أَمَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى.
verses.en: And the skilfully woven band, that was upon it, wherewith to gird it on, was of the same piece and like the work thereof: of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.kjv: And the curious girdle of his ephod, that [was] upon it, [was] of the same, according to the work thereof; [of] gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.web: The skillfully woven band that was on it, with which to fasten it on, was of the same piece, like its work: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

verses.he: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֙ אֶת־אַבְנֵ֣י הַשֹּׁ֔הַם מֻֽסַבֹּ֖ת מִשְׁבְּצֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב מְפֻתָּחֹת֙ פִּתּוּחֵ֣י חֹותָ֔ם עַל־שְׁמֹ֖ות בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.ar: وَصَنَعُوا حَجَرَيِ ٱلْجَزْعِ مُحَاطَيْنِ بِطَوْقَيْنِ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ مَنْقُوشَيْنِ نَقْشَ ٱلْخَاتِمِ عَلَى حَسَبِ أَسْمَاءِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.en: And they wrought the onyx stones, inclosed in settings of gold, graven with the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the children of Israel.
verses.kjv: ¶ And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold, graven, as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Israel.
verses.web: They worked the onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold, engraved with the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the children of Israel.

verses.he: וַיָּ֣שֶׂם אֹתָ֗ם עַ֚ל כִּתְפֹ֣ת הָאֵפֹ֔ד אַבְנֵ֥י זִכָּרֹ֖ון לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ פ
verses.ar: وَوَضَعَهُمَا عَلَى كَتِفَيِ ٱلرِّدَاءِ حَجَرَيْ تَذْكَارٍ لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ، كَمَا أَمَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى.
verses.en: And he put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.kjv: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod, [that they should be] stones for a memorial to the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.web: He put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

verses.he: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ אֶת־הַחֹ֛שֶׁן מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֖ב כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֵפֹ֑ד זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתֹולַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָֽר׃
verses.ar: وَصَنَعَ ٱلصُّدْرَةَ صَنْعَةَ ٱلْمُوَشِّي كَصَنْعَةِ ٱلرِّدَاءِ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَأَسْمَانْجُونِيٍّ وَأُرْجُوَانٍ وَقِرْمِزٍ وَبُوصٍ مَبْرُومٍ.
verses.en: And he made the breastplate, the work of the skilful workman, like the work of the ephod: of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.kjv: ¶ And he made the breastplate [of] cunning work, like the work of the ephod; [of] gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.web: He made the breastplate, the work of a skillful workman, like the work of the ephod: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

verses.he: רָב֧וּעַ הָיָ֛ה כָּפ֖וּל עָשׂ֣וּ אֶת־הַחֹ֑שֶׁן זֶ֧רֶת אָרְכֹּ֛ו וְזֶ֥רֶת רָחְבֹּ֖ו כָּפֽוּל׃
verses.ar: كَانَتْ مُرَبَّعَةً. مَثْنِيَّةً صَنَعُوا ٱلصُّدْرَةَ. طُولُهَا شِبْرٌ وَعَرْضُهَا شِبْرٌ مَثْنِيَّةً.
verses.en: It was four-square; they made the breastplate double; a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being double.
verses.kjv: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span [was] the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, [being] doubled.
verses.web: It was square. They made the breastplate double. Its length was a span, and its width a span, being double.

verses.he: וַיְמַלְאוּ־בֹ֔ו אַרְבָּעָ֖ה ט֣וּרֵי אָ֑בֶן ט֗וּר אֹ֤דֶם פִּטְדָה֙ וּבָרֶ֔קֶת הַטּ֖וּר הָאֶחָֽד׃
verses.ar: وَرَصَّعُوا فِيهَا أَرْبَعَةَ صُفُوفِ حِجَارَةٍ. صَفُّ: عَقِيقٌ أَحْمَرُ وَيَاقُوتٌ أَصْفَرُ وَزُمُرُّدٌ، ٱلصَّفُّ ٱلْأَوَّلُ.
verses.en: And they set in it four rows of stones: a row of carnelian, topaz, and smaragd was the first row.
verses.kjv: And they set in it four rows of stones: [the first] row [was] a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this [was] the first row.
verses.web: They set in it four rows of stones. A row of ruby, topaz, and beryl was the first row;

verses.he: וְהַטּ֖וּר הַשֵּׁנִ֑י נֹ֥פֶךְ סַפִּ֖יר וְיָהֲלֹֽם׃
verses.ar: وَٱلصَّفُّ ٱلثَّانِي: بَهْرَمَانُ وَيَاقُوتٌ أَزْرَقُ وَعَقِيقٌ أَبْيَضُ.
verses.en: And the second row, a carbuncle, a sapphire, and an emerald.
verses.kjv: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
verses.web: and the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;

verses.he: וְהַטּ֖וּר הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י לֶ֥שֶׁם שְׁבֹ֖ו וְאַחְלָֽמָה׃
verses.ar: وَٱلصَّفُّ ٱلثَّالِثُ: عَيْنُ ٱلْهِرِّ وَيَشْمٌ وَجَمَسْتُ.
verses.en: And the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst.
verses.kjv: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
verses.web: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

verses.he: וְהַטּוּר֙ הָֽרְבִיעִ֔י תַּרְשִׁ֥ישׁ שֹׁ֖הַם וְיָשְׁפֵ֑ה מֽוּסַבֹּ֛ת מִשְׁבְּצֹ֥ות זָהָ֖ב בְּמִלֻּאֹתָֽם׃
verses.ar: وَٱلصَّفُّ ٱلرَّابِعُ: زَبَرْجَدٌ وَجَزْعٌ وَيَشْبٌ. مُحَاطَةٌ بِأَطْوَاقٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ فِي تَرْصِيعِهَا.
verses.en: And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper; they were inclosed in fittings of gold in their settings.
verses.kjv: And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: [they were] inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings.
verses.web: and the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They were enclosed in gold settings.

verses.he: וְ֠הָאֲבָנִים עַל־שְׁמֹ֨ת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל הֵ֛נָּה שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה עַל־שְׁמֹתָ֑ם פִּתּוּחֵ֤י חֹתָם֙ אִ֣ישׁ עַל־שְׁמֹ֔ו לִשְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר שָֽׁבֶט׃
verses.ar: وَٱلْحِجَارَةُ كَانَتْ عَلَى أَسْمَاءِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ، ٱثْنَيْ عَشَرَ عَلَى أَسْمَائِهِمْ كَنَقْشِ ٱلْخَاتِمِ. كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ عَلَى ٱسْمِهِ لِلِٱثْنَيْ عَشَرَ سِبْطًا.
verses.en: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, every one according to his name, for the twelve tribes.
verses.kjv: And the stones [were] according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, [like] the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.
verses.web: The stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, for the twelve tribes.

verses.he: וַיַּעֲשׂ֧וּ עַל־הַחֹ֛שֶׁן שַׁרְשְׁרֹ֥ת גַּבְלֻ֖ת מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה עֲבֹ֑ת זָהָ֖ב טָהֹֽור׃
verses.ar: وَصَنَعُوا عَلَى ٱلصُّدْرَةِ سَلَاسِلَ مَجْدُولَةً صَنْعَةَ ٱلضَّفْرِ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ نَقِيٍّ.
verses.en: And they made upon the breastplate plaited chains, of wreathen work of pure gold.
verses.kjv: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends, [of] wreathen work [of] pure gold.
verses.web: They made on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.

verses.he: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֗וּ שְׁתֵּי֙ מִשְׁבְּצֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב וּשְׁתֵּ֖י טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב וֽ͏ַיִּתְּנ֗וּ אֶת־שְׁתֵּי֙ הַטַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַל־שְׁנֵ֖י קְצֹ֥ות הַחֹֽשֶׁן׃
verses.ar: وَصَنَعُوا طَوْقَيْنِ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَحَلْقَتَيْنِ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، وَجَعَلُوا ٱلْحَلْقَتَيْنِ عَلَى طَرَفَيِ ٱلصُّدْرَةِ.
verses.en: And they made two settings of gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
verses.kjv: And they made two ouches [of] gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.
verses.web: They made two settings of gold, and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

verses.he: וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ שְׁתֵּי֙ הָעֲבֹתֹ֣ת הַזָּהָ֔ב עַל־שְׁתֵּ֖י הַטַּבָּעֹ֑ת עַל־קְצֹ֖ות הַחֹֽשֶׁן׃
verses.ar: وَجَعَلُوا ضَفِيرَتَيِ ٱلذَّهَبِ فِي ٱلْحَلْقَتَيْنِ عَلَى طَرَفَيِ ٱلصُّدْرَةِ.
verses.en: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold on the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.
verses.kjv: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.
verses.web: They put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

verses.he: וְאֵ֨ת שְׁתֵּ֤י קְצֹות֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הָֽעֲבֹתֹ֔ת נָתְנ֖וּ עַל־שְׁתֵּ֣י הַֽמִּשְׁבְּצֹ֑ת וַֽיִּתְּנֻ֛ם עַל־כִּתְפֹ֥ת הָאֵפֹ֖ד אֶל־מ֥וּל פָּנָֽיו׃
verses.ar: وَطَرَفَا ٱلضَّفِيرَتَيْنِ جَعَلُوهُمَا فِي ٱلطَّوْقَيْنِ، وَجَعَلُوهُمَا عَلَى كَتِفَيِ ٱلرِّدَاءِ إِلَى قُدَّامِهِ.
verses.en: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, in the forepart thereof.
verses.kjv: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.
verses.web: The other two ends of the two braided chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, in its front.

verses.he: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֗וּ שְׁתֵּי֙ טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב וַיָּשִׂ֕ימוּ עַל־שְׁנֵ֖י קְצֹ֣ות הַחֹ֑שֶׁן עַל־שְׂפָתֹ֕ו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אֶל־עֵ֥בֶר הָאֵפֹ֖ד בָּֽיְתָה׃
verses.ar: وَصَنَعُوا حَلْقَتَيْنِ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَوَضَعُوهُمَا عَلَى طَرَفَيِ ٱلصُّدْرَةِ. عَلَى حَاشِيَتِهَا ٱلَّتِي إِلَى جِهَةِ ٱلرِّدَاءِ مِنْ دَاخِلٍ.
verses.en: And they made two rings of gold, and put them upon the two ends of the breastplate, upon the edge thereof, which was toward the side of the ephod inward.
verses.kjv: And they made two rings of gold, and put [them] on the two ends of the breastplate, upon the border of it, which [was] on the side of the ephod inward.
verses.web: They made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which was toward the side of the ephod inward.

verses.he: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֮ שְׁתֵּ֣י טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָב֒ וַֽיִּתְּנֻ֡ם עַל־שְׁתֵּי֩ כִתְפֹ֨ת הָאֵפֹ֤ד מִלְמַ֙טָּה֙ מִמּ֣וּל פָּנָ֔יו לְעֻמַּ֖ת מֶחְבַּרְתֹּ֑ו מִמַּ֕עַל לְחֵ֖שֶׁב הָאֵפֹֽד׃
verses.ar: وَصَنَعُوا حَلْقَتَيْنِ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَجَعَلُوهُمَا عَلَى كَتِفَيِ ٱلرِّدَاءِ مِنْ أَسْفَلُ مِنْ قُدَّامِهِ عِنْدَ وَصْلِهِ فَوْقَ زُنَّارِ ٱلرِّدَاءِ.
verses.en: And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder-pieces of the ephod underneath, in the forepart thereof, close by the coupling thereof, above the skilfully woven band of the ephod.
verses.kjv: And they made two [other] golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against the [other] coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.
verses.web: They made two more rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its front, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

verses.he: וַיִּרְכְּס֣וּ אֶת־הַחֹ֡שֶׁן מִטַּבְּעֹתָיו֩ אֶל־טַבְּעֹ֨ת הָאֵפֹ֜ד בִּפְתִ֣יל תְּכֵ֗לֶת לִֽהְיֹת֙ עַל־חֵ֣שֶׁב הָאֵפֹ֔ד וְלֹֽא־יִזַּ֣ח הַחֹ֔שֶׁן מֵעַ֖ל הָאֵפֹ֑ד כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.ar: وَرَبَطُوا ٱلصُّدْرَةَ بِحَلْقَتَيْهَا إِلَى حَلْقَتَيِ ٱلرِّدَاءِ بِخَيْطٍ مِنْ أَسْمَانْجُونِيٍّ لِيَكُونَ عَلَى زُنَّارِ ٱلرِّدَاءِ، وَلَا تُنْزَعُ ٱلصُّدْرَةُ عَنِ ٱلرِّدَاءِ، كَمَا أَمَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى.
verses.en: And they did bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a thread of blue, that it might be upon the skilfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.kjv: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.web: They bound the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not come loose from the ephod, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

verses.he: וַיַּ֛עַשׂ אֶת־מְעִ֥יל הָאֵפֹ֖ד מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֹרֵ֑ג כְּלִ֖יל תְּכֵֽלֶת׃
verses.ar: وَصَنَعَ جُبَّةَ ٱلرِّدَاءِ صَنْعَةَ ٱلنَّسَّاجِ، كُلَّهَا مِنْ أَسْمَانْجُونِيٍّ.
verses.en: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue;
verses.kjv: ¶ And he made the robe of the ephod [of] woven work, all [of] blue.
verses.web: He made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.

verses.he: וּפִֽי־הַמְּעִ֥יל בְּתֹוכֹ֖ו כְּפִ֣י תַחְרָ֑א שָׂפָ֥ה לְפִ֛יו סָבִ֖יב לֹ֥א יִקָּרֵֽעַ׃
verses.ar: وَفَتْحَةُ ٱلْجُبَّةِ فِي وَسَطِهَا كَفَتْحَةِ ٱلدِّرْعِ، وَلِفَتْحَتِهَا حَاشِيَةٌ حَوَالَيْهَا. لَا تَنْشَقُّ.
verses.en: and the hole of the robe in the midst thereof, as the hole of a coat of mail, with a binding round about the hole of it, that it should not be rent.
verses.kjv: And [there was] an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon, [with] a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.
verses.web: The opening of the robe in the middle of it was like the opening of a coat of mail, with a binding around its opening, that it should not be torn.

verses.he: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֙ עַל־שׁוּלֵ֣י הַמְּעִ֔יל רִמֹּונֵ֕י תְּכֵ֥לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֖ן וְתֹולַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֑י מָשְׁזָֽר׃
verses.ar: وَصَنَعُوا عَلَى أَذْيَالِ ٱلْجُبَّةِ رُمَّانَاتٍ مِنْ أَسْمَانْجُونِيٍّ وَأُرْجُوَانٍ وَقِرْمِزٍ مَبْرُومٍ.
verses.en: And they made upon the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.
verses.kjv: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates [of] blue, and purple, and scarlet, [and] twined [linen].
verses.web: They made on the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, purple, scarlet, and twined linen.

verses.he: וַיַּעֲשׂ֥וּ פַעֲמֹנֵ֖י זָהָ֣ב טָהֹ֑ור וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ אֶת־הַפַּֽעֲמֹנִ֜ים בְּתֹ֣וךְ הָרִמֹּנִ֗ים עַל־שׁוּלֵ֤י הַמְּעִיל֙ סָבִ֔יב בְּתֹ֖וךְ הָרִמֹּנִֽים׃
verses.ar: وَصَنَعُوا جَلَاجِلَ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ نَقِيٍّ، وَجَعَلُوا ٱلْجَلَاجِلَ فِي وَسَطِ ٱلرُّمَّانَاتِ عَلَى أَذْيَالِ ٱلْجُبَّةِ حَوَالَيْهَا فِي وَسَطِ ٱلرُّمَّانَاتِ.
verses.en: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the skirts of the robe round about, between the pomegranates:
verses.kjv: And they made bells [of] pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates;
verses.web: They made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates around the skirts of the robe, between the pomegranates;

verses.he: פַּעֲמֹ֤ן וְרִמֹּן֙ פַּעֲמֹ֣ן וְרִמֹּ֔ן עַל־שׁוּלֵ֥י הַמְּעִ֖יל סָבִ֑יב לְשָׁרֵ֕ת כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ ס
verses.ar: جُلْجُلٌ وَرُمَّانَةٌ. جُلْجُلٌ وَرُمَّانَةٌ. عَلَى أَذْيَالِ ٱلْجُبَّةِ حَوَالَيْهَا لِلْخِدْمَةِ، كَمَا أَمَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى.
verses.en: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, upon the skirts of the robe round about, to minister in; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.kjv: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister [in;] as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.web: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, around the skirts of the robe, to minister in, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

verses.he: וֽ͏ַיַּעֲשׂ֛וּ אֶת־הַכָּתְנֹ֥ת שֵׁ֖שׁ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֹרֵ֑ג לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָֽיו׃
verses.ar: وَصَنَعُوا ٱلْأَقْمِصَةَ مِنْ بُوصٍ صَنْعَةَ ٱلنَّسَّاجِ لِهَارُونَ وَبَنِيهِ.
verses.en: And they made the tunics of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,
verses.kjv: ¶ And they made coats [of] fine linen [of] woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,
verses.web: They made the tunics of fine linen of woven work for Aaron and for his sons,

verses.he: וְאֵת֙ הַמִּצְנֶ֣פֶת שֵׁ֔שׁ וְאֶת־פַּאֲרֵ֥י הַמִּגְבָּעֹ֖ת שֵׁ֑שׁ וְאֶת־מִכְנְסֵ֥י הַבָּ֖ד שֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָֽר׃
verses.ar: وَٱلْعِمَامَةَ مِنْ بُوصٍ، وَعَصَائِبَ ٱلْقَلَانِسِ مِنْ بُوصٍ، وَسَرَاوِيلَ ٱلْكَتَّانِ مِنْ بُوصٍ مَبْرُومٍ.
verses.en: and the mitre of fine linen, and the goodly head-tires of fine linen, and the linen breeches of fine twined linen,
verses.kjv: And a mitre [of] fine linen, and goodly bonnets [of] fine linen, and linen breeches [of] fine twined linen,
verses.web: the turban of fine linen, the linen headbands of fine linen, the linen trousers of fine twined linen,

verses.he: וְֽאֶת־הָאַבְנֵ֞ט שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֗ר וּתְכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתֹולַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רֹקֵ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ ס
verses.ar: وَٱلْمِنْطَقَةَ مِنْ بُوصٍ مَبْرُومٍ وَأَسْمَانْجُونِيٍّ وَأُرْجُوَانٍ وَقِرْمِزٍ صَنْعَةَ ٱلطَّرَّازِ، كَمَا أَمَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى.
verses.en: and the girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, the work of the weaver in colours; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.kjv: And a girdle [of] fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, [of] needlework; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.web: the sash of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet, the work of the embroiderer, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

verses.he: וֽ͏ַיַּעֲשׂ֛וּ אֶת־צִ֥יץ נֵֽזֶר־הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ זָהָ֣ב טָהֹ֑ור וַיִּכְתְּב֣וּ עָלָ֗יו מִכְתַּב֙ פִּתּוּחֵ֣י חֹותָ֔ם קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: وَصَنَعُوا صَفِيحَةَ ٱلْإِكْلِيلِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ نَقِيٍّ، وَكَتَبُوا عَلَيْهَا كِتَابَةَ نَقْشِ ٱلْخَاتِمِ: «قُدْسٌ لِلرَّبِّ».
verses.en: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like the engravings of a signet: HOLY TO THE LORD.
verses.kjv: ¶ And they made the plate of the holy crown [of] pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, [like to] the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
verses.web: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription, like the engravings of a signet: “HOLY TO YAHWEH”.

verses.he: וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ עָלָיו֙ פְּתִ֣יל תְּכֵ֔לֶת לָתֵ֥ת עַל־הַמִּצְנֶ֖פֶת מִלְמָ֑עְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ ס
verses.ar: وَجَعَلُوا عَلَيْهَا خَيْطَ أَسْمَانْجُونِيٍّ لِتُجْعَلَ عَلَى ٱلْعِمَامَةِ مِنْ فَوْقُ، كَمَا أَمَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى.
verses.en: And they tied unto it a thread of blue, to fasten it upon the mitre above; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.kjv: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten [it] on high upon the mitre; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.web: They tied to it a lace of blue, to fasten it on the turban above, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

verses.he: וַתֵּ֕כֶל כָּל־עֲבֹדַ֕ת מִשְׁכַּ֖ן אֹ֣הֶל מֹועֵ֑ד וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֖ה כֵּ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ׃ פ
verses.ar: فَكَمُلَ كُلُّ عَمَلِ مَسْكَنِ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ. وَصَنَعَ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ بِحَسَبِ كُلِّ مَا أَمَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى. هَكَذَا صَنَعُوا.
verses.en: Thus was finished all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting; and the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.
verses.kjv: ¶ Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.
verses.web: Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting was finished. The children of Israel did according to all that Yahweh commanded Moses; so they did.

verses.he: וַיָּבִ֤יאוּ אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת־הָאֹ֖הֶל וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֑יו קְרָסָ֣יו קְרָשָׁ֔יו *בְּרִיחֹו (בְּרִיחָ֖יו) וְעַמֻּדָ֥יו וַאֲדָנָֽיו׃
verses.ar: وَجَاءُوا إِلَى مُوسَى بِٱلْمَسْكَنِ: ٱلْخَيْمَةِ وَجَمِيعِ أَوَانِيهَا، أَشِظَّتِهَا وَأَلْوَاحِهَا وَعَوَارِضِهَا وَأَعْمِدَتِهَا وَقَوَاعِدِهَا،
verses.en: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the Tent, and all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, and its pillars, and its sockets;
verses.kjv: ¶ And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,
verses.web: They brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent, with all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,

verses.he: וְאֶת־מִכְסֵ֞ה עֹורֹ֤ת הָֽאֵילִם֙ הַמְאָדָּמִ֔ים וְאֶת־מִכְסֵ֖ה עֹרֹ֣ת הַתְּחָשִׁ֑ים וְאֵ֖ת פָּרֹ֥כֶת הַמָּסָֽךְ׃
verses.ar: وَٱلْغِطَاءِ مِنْ جُلُودِ ٱلْكِبَاشِ ٱلْمُحَمَّرَةِ، وَٱلْغِطَاءِ مِنْ جُلُودِ ٱلتُّخَسِ، وَحِجَابِ ٱلسَّجْفِ،
verses.en: and the covering of rams' skins dyed red, and the covering of sealskins, and the veil of the screen;
verses.kjv: And the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers’ skins, and the vail of the covering,
verses.web: the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, the covering of sea cow hides, the veil of the screen,

verses.he: אֶת־אֲרֹ֥ן הָעֵדֻ֖ת וְאֶת־בַּדָּ֑יו וְאֵ֖ת הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת׃
verses.ar: وَتَابُوتِ ٱلشَّهَادَةِ وَعَصَوَيْهِ، وَٱلْغِطَاءِ،
verses.en: the ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the ark-cover;
verses.kjv: The ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat,
verses.web: the ark of the covenant with its poles, the mercy seat,

verses.he: אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ אֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֔יו וְאֵ֖ת לֶ֥חֶם הַפָּנִֽים׃
verses.ar: وَٱلْمَائِدَةِ وَكُلِّ آنِيَتِهَا، وَخُبْزِ ٱلْوُجُوهِ،
verses.en: the table, all the vessels thereof, and the showbread;
verses.kjv: The table, [and] all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,
verses.web: the table, all its vessels, the show bread,

verses.he: אֶת־הַמְּנֹרָ֨ה הַטְּהֹרָ֜ה אֶת־נֵרֹתֶ֗יהָ נֵרֹ֛ת הַמַּֽעֲרָכָ֖ה וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֖ת שֶׁ֥מֶן הַמָּאֹֽור׃
verses.ar: وَٱلْمَنَارَةِ ٱلطَّاهِرَةِ وَسُرُجِهَا: ٱلسُّرُجِ لِلتَّرْتِيبِ، وَكُلِّ آنِيَتِهَا وَٱلزَّيْتِ لِلضَّوْءِ،
verses.en: the pure candlestick, the lamps thereof, even the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for the light;
verses.kjv: The pure candlestick, [with] the lamps thereof, [even with] the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light,
verses.web: the pure lamp stand, its lamps, even the lamps to be set in order, all its vessels, the oil for the light,

verses.he: וְאֵת֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הַזָּהָ֔ב וְאֵת֙ שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת קְטֹ֣רֶת הַסַּמִּ֑ים וְאֵ֕ת מָסַ֖ךְ פֶּ֥תַח הָאֹֽהֶל׃
verses.ar: وَمَذْبَحِ ٱلذَّهَبِ، وَدُهْنِ ٱلْمَسْحَةِ، وَٱلْبَخُورِ ٱلْعَطِرِ، وَٱلسَّجْفِ لِمَدْخَلِ ٱلْخَيْمَةِ،
verses.en: and the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the screen for the door of the Tent;
verses.kjv: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door,
verses.web: the golden altar, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door of the Tent,

verses.he: אֵ֣ת ׀ מִזְבַּ֣ח הַנְּחֹ֗שֶׁת וְאֶת־מִכְבַּ֤ר הַנְּחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ אֲשֶׁר־לֹ֔ו אֶת־בַּדָּ֖יו וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֑יו אֶת־הַכִּיֹּ֖ר וְאֶת־כַּנֹּֽו׃
verses.ar: وَمَذْبَحِ ٱلنُّحَاسِ، وَشُبَّاكَةِ ٱلنُّحَاسِ ٱلَّتِي لَهُ وَعَصَوَيْهِ وَكُلِّ آنِيَتِهِ، وَٱلْمِرْحَضَةِ وَقَاعِدَتِهَا،
verses.en: the brazen altar, and its grating of brass, its staves, and all its vessels, the laver and its base;
verses.kjv: The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
verses.web: the bronze altar, its grating of bronze, its poles, all of its vessels, the basin and its base,

verses.he: אֵת֩ קַלְעֵ֨י הֶחָצֵ֜ר אֶת־עַמֻּדֶ֣יהָ וְאֶת־אֲדָנֶ֗יהָ וְאֶת־הַמָּסָךְ֙ לְשַׁ֣עַר הֶֽחָצֵ֔ר אֶת־מֵיתָרָ֖יו וִיתֵדֹתֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֗ת כָּל־כְּלֵ֛י עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן לְאֹ֥הֶל מֹועֵֽד׃
verses.ar: وَأَسْتَارِ ٱلدَّارِ وَأَعْمِدَتِهَا وَقَوَاعِدِهَا، وَٱلسَّجْفِ لِبَابِ ٱلدَّارِ وَأَطْنَابِهَا وَأَوْتَادِهَا، وَجَمِيعِ أَوَانِي خِدْمَةِ ٱلْمَسْكَنِ لِخَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ،
verses.en: the hangings of the court, its pillars, and its sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court, the cords thereof, and the pins thereof, and all the instruments of the service of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting;
verses.kjv: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,
verses.web: the hangings of the court, its pillars, its sockets, the screen for the gate of the court, its cords, its pins, and all the instruments of the service of the tabernacle, for the Tent of Meeting,

verses.he: אֶת־בִּגְדֵ֥י הַשְּׂרָ֖ד לְשָׁרֵ֣ת בַּקֹּ֑דֶשׁ אֶת־בִּגְדֵ֤י הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ לְאַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶת־בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו לְכַהֵֽן׃
verses.ar: وَٱلثِّيَابِ ٱلْمَنْسُوجَةِ لِلْخِدْمَةِ فِي ٱلْمَقْدِسِ، وَٱلثِّيَابِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَةِ لِهَارُونَ ٱلْكَاهِنِ وَثِيَابِ بَنِيهِ لِلْكَهَانَةِ.
verses.en: the plaited garments for ministering in the holy place; the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office.
verses.kjv: The cloths of service to do service in the holy [place], and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons’ garments, to minister in the priest’s office.
verses.web: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.

verses.he: כְּכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֑ה כֵּ֤ן עָשׂוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵ֖ת כָּל־הָעֲבֹדָֽה׃
verses.ar: بِحَسَبِ كُلِّ مَا أَمَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى هَكَذَا صَنَعَ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ كُلَّ ٱلْعَمَلِ.
verses.en: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.
verses.kjv: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel made all the work.
verses.web: According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.

verses.he: וַיַּ֨רְא מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־כָּל־הַמְּלָאכָ֗ה וְהִנֵּה֙ עָשׂ֣וּ אֹתָ֔הּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה כֵּ֣ן עָשׂ֑וּ וַיְבָ֥רֶךְ אֹתָ֖ם מֹשֶֽׁה׃ פ
verses.ar: فَنَظَرَ مُوسَى جَمِيعَ ٱلْعَمَلِ، وَإِذَا هُمْ قَدْ صَنَعُوهُ كَمَا أَمَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ. هَكَذَا صَنَعُوا. فَبَارَكَهُمْ مُوسَى.
verses.en: And Moses saw all the work, and, behold, they had done it; as the LORD had commanded, even so had they done it. And Moses blessed them.
verses.kjv: And Moses did look upon all the work, and, behold, they had done it as the LORD had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.
verses.web: Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as Yahweh had commanded. They had done so; and Moses blessed them.
